subject: The Meeting That Runs Itself
preview_text: One AI setup that eliminates 3 hours of meeting admin every week.

big_idea.headline: Meetings Don't Waste Time. The Work Around Meetings Does.
big_idea.body: The average professional spends 4.5 hours per week preparing for, summarising, and following up on meetings. The meeting itself is rarely the problem — it's the 90 minutes before and after that nobody accounts for. AI doesn't eliminate meetings. But it can eliminate almost everything around them: agenda drafting, note-taking, action item extraction, and follow-up emails. Done right, you walk in, you talk, you walk out — and the documentation handles itself.
big_idea.highlight: The goal isn't fewer meetings. It's zero meeting admin.

tool.name: Otter.ai
tool.tagline: Automatic transcription, summaries, and action items from every call
tool.description: Otter joins your Google Meet, Zoom, or Teams call automatically. It transcribes in real-time, highlights action items, and generates a summary you can share within minutes of hanging up. No more 'can someone take notes' — Otter is always taking notes.
tool.best_for: Founders, consultants, and team leads running 5+ meetings per week

prompt.context: Paste this into ChatGPT or Claude after your next meeting. Give it your raw notes or Otter transcript and watch it do the admin:
prompt.text:
You are a professional executive assistant.

I just finished a meeting. Here are the raw notes/transcript:
[PASTE NOTES HERE]

Please produce:
1. A 3-sentence meeting summary
2. A bulleted list of action items with owner names and deadlines
3. A ready-to-send follow-up email to all participants

Tone: professional, concise, no filler.
prompt.why_it_works: This prompt forces structure. Most people paste notes and hope for the best — this tells the AI exactly what format to return, so you get output you can use immediately without editing.

stat.label: Per week lost to meeting admin — per person
stat.context: That's 234 hours a year. Nearly 6 full work weeks. Across a 10-person team, that's 2,340 hours — the equivalent of hiring a full-time employee just to handle meeting paperwork. AI eliminates most of it.
